The crew spent most of the day transporting spice bags containing scotch broom from areas in the upper Camas hill covenant to the bottom driveway of the property. Crew did a combination of fireline rolls, carrying, and dragging (only on none sensistive areas like the pipe and lower cement driveway) to transport the bags from higher elevation down to the bottom of the driveway. There were approximately 15 spices bags with completely dried plant material and 5 crew members which took them ~5 hours. This system of removing plant matter in late spring/early summer and leaving bags near removal sites in non-sensitive areas, then transporting in late summer when plant marterial has dried out,  much lighter, and all the sensitive wildflowers are no longer in bloom was very successful. Crew the last few hours of the day doing admin office hours.
